$comment: Model-evaluation cases for docs/working/AI_EVALUATION.md. Each `input` has the exact shape the server sends to the provider (ExplanationInput in server/ai/provider.ts), already minimized and truncated. Destinations are fictional unless `realPlaces` is true; real places use only short, generic descriptions. No personal data.

cases.title: English, five results at the truncation limits
cases.purpose: Largest input: output length, JSON completeness within the token cap, latency, and Neurons.

destinations.name: Port Calder
destinations.summary: A harbour town built around a sheltered bay, Port Calder mixes old warehouses turned into galleries with a long waterfront promenade. Mornings are busy at the covered fish market, while afternoons are slower, with cafés along the quay and small boats heading out to the nearby islets. The old town above the harbour has narrow lanes, a hilltop chapel, and viewpoints over the bay. Most sights are within walking distance, and a coastal path connects the town to quiet coves to the north.
highlights: Covered fish market on the quay
Hilltop chapel with views over the bay
Coastal path to the northern coves
Boat trips to the nearby islets

destinations.name: Vel Amara
destinations.summary: Vel Amara is a walled inland city known for its layered history: a medieval citadel, a cathedral square, and a network of courtyards that now hold workshops and small museums. Outside the walls, terraced vineyards and olive groves cover the hillsides. Visitors usually split their time between the old quarter and day walks through the surrounding countryside, returning in the evening for meals in the courtyard restaurants.
highlights: Courtyard restaurants in the old quarter

destinations.name: Lake Morrow Highlands
destinations.summary: A highland area of lakes, pine forest, and open moorland. Trails range from flat lakeside loops to longer ridge walks, and several villages offer guesthouses and simple local food. It is a place for slow days outdoors rather than sightseeing, with boating on the lakes and quiet evenings in the villages.
highlights: Rowing boats on the main lake

destinations.name: Sarnet Old Quarter
destinations.summary: The old quarter of Sarnet is a compact district of trading houses, a former customs hall, and a riverside market. Its museums focus on the history of river trade, and the streets are lined with bakeries and family-run eateries. Evenings are lively around the market square.

destinations.name: Isle of Brannoch
destinations.summary: A windswept island with cliffs, seabird colonies, and long empty beaches. There are a few small villages with cafés and a single coastal road. Visitors come for walks, scenery, and the feeling of distance from busy places.
